subject: forky
label: A forklift is mostly trellis
from: TWO SEPARATE DEATHS. Forky filed as a casualty with no afterlife; the van filed as a corpse Ivy happened to want
to: ONE PIPELINE. Sera and Bella break it, IVY PLANTS IN IT, and it works.
note:
THE ARCHIVE HAD BOTH FACTS AND NEITHER CONNECTION. Forky’s record ended at the sixth thrust and the popped wheels; it never said WHERE HE WENT. The van’s record had Ivy claiming it and read as opportunism. PUT THEM TOGETHER AND IT IS A PRACTICE WITH A PRECEDENT.

FORKY WENT INTO THE BEDS AND FORKY TOOK. That is the load-bearing fact, because it is the reason Ivy moved on the van within the hour and the reason she was not angry. SHE HAS WANTED A NEW VEHICLE EVER SINCE. A woman collecting on a proven method is a different woman than a woman salvaging wreckage, and the Archive had written the second one.

AND IT EXPLAINS BREAK THE NEXT ONE IN THE GARDEN. Not a joke, not a jab. LOGISTICS.

SCOPED DELIBERATELY: THE LINEAGE IS VEHICLES. Furniture dies in this house on its own ledger with its own culprits, and the Archive is not merging the two to make a tidier system.
